properties.statement: THE `satisfies` HELPER CANNOT EXPRESS THE COVERAGE THE SCHEMA DOCUMENTS, SO PARTIAL SATISFACTION IS RECORDED AS FULL. `describe_schema` documents `coverage: full|partial|planned` and `evidence` on SATISFIES; the typed helper accepts neither. Two capabilities were linked in one session that each serve HALF of their requirement — one covers a requirement's 'capture' half while its 'mine backward' half is served by nothing — and both now read as flat satisfaction to any rollup, with the qualification surviving only in prose a rollup does not count. THE FAILURE DIRECTION IS OVER-CLAIMING, SILENTLY, ON THE EDGE THE SKILLS THEMSELVES CALL 'the backbone of design traceability'. The same shape applies to the other typed edge helpers that drop documented edge properties. || SOURCE: Observed by the dev_storyflow fleet on 2026-08-15, on reflow2 0.31.0 with served == installed verified through /proc/<pid>/exe. Three agent seats, one shared graph, one day.
